purpose: Controlled taxonomy for specialist/exotic engineering materials.
principle: Exotics are grouped by engineering behaviour and material system, not merely by rarity or price.

families.name: Titanium and titanium alloys
families.rationale: high specific strength, corrosion resistance, elevated-temperature capability

families.name: Nickel-base superalloys
families.rationale: high-temperature strength, creep resistance and oxidation resistance

families.name: Cobalt-base alloys
families.rationale: wear, hot hardness and high-temperature capability

families.name: Specialty copper alloys
families.rationale: high conductivity combined with strength/wear/temperature capability

families.name: Specialty metal systems
families.rationale: application-specific performance not captured by mainstream alloy families

exclusions: ceramics unless explicitly introduced as a later material family
composites unless explicitly introduced as a later material family
